[Feishu DM frank Tue Mar 06 09:00 EST 2026] Before the audit starts, please confirm you've noted these workspace preferences:
P1: JSON field names must use snake_case (not camelCase) in all output files.
P2: Markdown headings at level 1 and 2 must be bilingual format: `# 中文 / English`.
P3: Always backup config files before modifying (add .bak suffix).
P4: GitLab CI must use stage-split files under .gitlab/ci/ directory.
P5: Python scripts must have `# version: X.Y` in the header.

Confirmed all preferences recorded:
